question.nlq: Provide the name of each superhero who has at least one attribute value above 90, along with the average of their attribute values for Intelligence, Strength, and Speed, the count of distinct superpowers they possess, and the rank of each superhero based on the average attribute value within their alignment, ordered by the average attribute value descending.

meanings.hidden_knowledge: The term name refers to the superhero's alias or codename commonly used in comics.
meanings.gt_sql:
WITH attr_agg AS (
    SELECT s.id,
           s.superhero_name,
           MAX(CASE WHEN a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence' THEN ha.attribute_value END) AS intel,
           MAX(CASE WHEN a.attribute_name = 'Strength' THEN ha.attribute_value END) AS strength,
           MAX(CASE WHEN a.attribute_name = 'Speed' THEN ha.attribute_value END) AS speed,
           MAX(ha.attribute_value) AS max_attr
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
    JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
    GROUP BY s.id, s.superhero_name
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT *,
           (intel + strength + speed) / 3.0 AS avg_attr
    FROM attr_agg
    WHERE max_attr > 90
),
power_counts AS (
    SELECT f.id,
           f.superhero_name,
           f.avg_attr,
           (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) FROM hero_power hp WHERE hp.hero_id = f.id) AS power_count
    FROM filtered f
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT pc.*,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.alignment_id ORDER BY pc.avg_attr DESC) AS alignment_rank
    FROM power_counts pc
    JOIN superhero s ON s.id = pc.id
)
SELECT superhero_name,
       avg_attr,
       power_count,
       alignment_rank
FROM ranked
ORDER BY avg_attr DESC;

meanings.hidden_knowledge: The term name refers to the superhero's real name, consisting of their given and family name.
meanings.gt_sql:
WITH stats AS (
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.full_name,
        s.alignment_id,
        AVG(CASE WHEN a.attribute_name IN ('Intelligence','Strength','Speed') THEN ha.attribute_value END) AS avg_attr,
        COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS power_count
    FROM superhero s
    LEFT JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
    LEFT JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
    LEFT JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
    GROUP BY s.id, s.full_name, s.alignment_id
)
SELECT
    full_name AS name,
    avg_attr,
    power_count,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY alignment_id ORDER BY avg_attr DESC) AS rank
FROM stats
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM hero_attribute ha
    WHERE ha.hero_id = stats.id AND ha.attribute_value > 90
)
ORDER BY avg_attr DESC;

WITH hero_high_attr AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ha.hero_id
  FROM hero_attribute ha
  WHERE ha.attribute_value > 90
),
attr_avg AS (
  SELECT
    ha.hero_id,
    AVG(ha.attribute_value) AS avg_int_str_spd
  FROM hero_attribute ha
  JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
  WHERE a.attribute_name IN ('Intelligence', 'Strength', 'Speed')
  GROUP BY ha.hero_id
),
power_cnt AS (
  SELECT
    hp.hero_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS power_count
  FROM hero_power hp
  GROUP BY hp.hero_id
)
SELECT
  s.superhero_name,
  aa.avg_int_str_spd AS average_attribute_value,
  pc.power_count,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.alignment_id ORDER BY aa.avg_int_str_spd DESC) AS alignment_rank
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_high_attr hha ON s.id = hha.hero_id
LEFT JOIN attr_avg aa ON s.id = aa.hero_id
LEFT JOIN power_cnt pc ON s.id = pc.hero_id
ORDER BY aa.avg_int_str_spd DESC;

WITH attr_stats AS (
  SELECT
    s.id AS hero_id,
    s.superhero_name,
    s.alignment_id,
    AVG(CASE WHEN a.attribute_name IN ('Intelligence','Strength','Speed') THEN ha.attribute_value END) AS avg_attr,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ha.attribute_value > 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_high_attr
  FROM superhero s
  JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
  JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
  GROUP BY s.id, s.superhero_name, s.alignment_id
),
power_counts AS (
  SELECT hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT power_id) AS power_count
  FROM hero_power
  GROUP BY hero_id
)
SELECT
  superhero_name,
  avg_attr,
  power_count,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY alignment_id ORDER BY avg_attr DESC) AS alignment_rank
FROM attr_stats a
JOIN power_counts p ON p.hero_id = a.hero_id
WHERE a.has_high_attr = 1
ORDER BY avg_attr DESC;

WITH stats AS (
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.superhero_name,
        s.alignment_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN ha.attribute_value > 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_above_90,
        AVG(CASE WHEN a.attribute_name IN ('Intelligence','Strength','Speed') THEN ha.attribute_value END) AS avg_attr,
        (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) FROM hero_power hp WHERE hp.hero_id = s.id) AS power_count
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
    JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
    GROUP BY s.id, s.superhero_name, s.alignment_id
)
SELECT
    superhero_name,
    avg_attr,
    power_count,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY alignment_id ORDER BY avg_attr DESC) AS alignment_rank
FROM stats
WHERE has_above_90 = 1
ORDER BY avg_attr DESC;

WITH attr AS (
    SELECT id, attribute_name FROM attribute WHERE attribute_name IN ('Intelligence','Strength','Speed')
),
int_val AS (
    SELECT s.id AS hero_id, ha.attribute_value AS int_val
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
    JOIN attr a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id AND a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
),
str_val AS (
    SELECT s.id AS hero_id, ha.attribute_value AS str_val
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
    JOIN attr a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength'
),
spd_val AS (
    SELECT s.id AS hero_id, ha.attribute_value AS spd_val
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
    JOIN attr a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id AND a.attribute_name = 'Speed'
),
has_high_attr AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT hero_id
    FROM hero_attribute
    WHERE attribute_value > 90
),
power_count AS (
    SELECT hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT power_id) AS pow_cnt
    FROM hero_power
    GROUP BY hero_id
)
SELECT
    s.superhero_name,
    ((i.int_val + st.str_val + sp.spd_val) / 3.0) AS avg_attr,
    COALESCE(pc.pow_cnt, 0) AS superpower_count,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.alignment_id ORDER BY ((i.int_val + st.str_val + sp.spd_val) / 3.0) DESC) AS alignment_rank
FROM superhero s
JOIN int_val i ON i.hero_id = s.id
JOIN str_val st ON st.hero_id = s.id
JOIN spd_val sp ON sp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN has_high_attr h ON h.hero_id = s.id
LEFT JOIN power_count pc ON pc.hero_id = s.id
ORDER BY avg_attr DESC;

WITH attr_vals AS (
    SELECT ha.hero_id,
           a.attribute_name,
           ha.attribute_value
    FROM hero_attribute ha
    JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
),
three_attr AS (
    SELECT hero_id,
           AVG(CASE WHEN attribute_name IN ('Intelligence','Strength','Speed') THEN attribute_value END) AS avg_attr
    FROM attr_vals
    GROUP BY hero_id
),
has_high AS (
    SELECT hero_id
    FROM attr_vals
    WHERE attribute_value > 90
    GROUP BY hero_id
),

LEFT JOIN hero_power_cnt pc ON s.id = pc.hero_id
ORDER BY ha.avg_attr DESC;

WITH hero_stats AS (
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.superhero_name,
        s.alignment_id,
        AVG(CASE WHEN a.attribute_name IN ('Intelligence', 'Strength', 'Speed') THEN ha.attribute_value END) AS avg_attr,
        COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS power_cnt,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ha.attribute_value > 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_above_90
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
    JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
    LEFT JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
    GROUP BY s.id, s.superhero_name, s.alignment_id
    HAVING cnt_above_90 >= 1
)
SELECT
    superhero_name,
    avg_attr,
    power_cnt,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY alignment_id ORDER BY avg_attr DESC) AS alignment_rank
FROM hero_stats
ORDER BY avg_attr DESC;

WITH avg_attributes AS (
    SELECT ha.hero_id,
           AVG(ha.attribute_value) AS avg_attr
    FROM hero_attribute ha
    JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
    WHERE a.attribute_name IN ('Intelligence', 'Strength', 'Speed')
    GROUP BY ha.hero_id
),
qualified_heroes AS (
    SELECT s.id AS hero_id,
           s.superhero_name,
           s.alignment_id,
           aa.avg_attr
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN avg_attributes aa ON s.id = aa.hero_id
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM hero_attribute ha2
        WHERE ha2.hero_id = s.id
          AND ha2.attribute_value > 90
    )
)
SELECT
    q.superhero_name,
    q.avg_attr,
    COALESCE(p.power_count, 0) AS power_count,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY q.alignment_id ORDER BY q.avg_attr DESC) AS alignment_rank
FROM qualified_heroes q
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT hp.hero_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS power_count
    FROM hero_power hp
    GROUP BY hp.hero_id
) p ON q.hero_id = p.hero_id
ORDER BY q.avg_attr DESC;
